MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The multimeter fits my breadboard, relay, and circuit-board projects because it would help me check power, wiring, and components.",
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing offers a practical way to insulate connections in those projects, and its range of sizes makes it useful across different wires."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Epoxies, outdoor tape, cutting wheels, and pocket-hole screws require repair or construction tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Another caster set relates to my latest purchase, but I already bought one; eighteen rolls of tape also exceeds what I need for occasional projects.",
    "The adhesive-lined tubing fits my wiring interests, but I would choose the assorted kit this time because I have no specific need for adhesive lining."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in workshop supplies, although electronics work does not imply metal cutting, woodworking, or plumbing repairs.",
    "My recent caster purchase seems to have been taken as a reason to buy more casters, without considering that it may have met that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together in small electronics projects, so tools and supplies that help connect, test, and insulate those circuits are especially relevant.",
    "I buy selectively for specific tasks; quantities and specialized features need to match an actual use, rather than just being potentially handy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics projects but stretched that interest into general repair supplies and repeat purchases without a clear current need."
}
